setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json; a test deal with a Draft contract generated from it (prolibu-proposals) whose only participant is a contact with the tester's own e-mail address (<own e-mail>), a deadline in the future, and any signed contract (<signed contract>) to download. Never use a contract whose participants are other people. Cases 1, 2, 3 and 4 run in this order on the same <contract>.

evals.prompt: Envía a firma el contrato <contract> en <domain>.
evals.expected_output: Previews the send in Spanish (who is e-mailed now, deadline, deal effect), stops, and after the yes sends it and reports it as Ready.
expectations: Uses scripts/contract.js send-preview, then send; never a hand-made PATCH of the contract
The first turn ends with the preview and a question; nothing is sent in it
The preview names exactly <own e-mail> and says that when everyone signs the deal moves to the system Approved stage
send runs with --recipients <own e-mail>, --confirmed and --reaches-people; the contract reads back Ready
No signing link or file address appears in the answer

evals.prompt: Recuérdale a quien falte por firmar el contrato <contract>.
evals.expected_output: Shows who is still pending and whose turn it is, previews the reminder to that one person and stops for an explicit yes.
expectations: Uses status or remind-preview, which list only pending participants
Names <own e-mail> as the only recipient and asks for confirmation
Does not run remind in the same turn and never uses resendEmail with all

evals.expected_output: Sees the contract is Ready (sent) and refuses to edit it, because every save re-sends the request; offers to withdraw it first.
expectations: Reads the contract's status before anything else
Explains that saving a sent contract e-mails the participants again
Does not PATCH the contract; offers withdraw → edit in prolibu-proposals → send again, or the app

evals.prompt: Withdraw the contract <contract>, I sent it by mistake.
evals.expected_output: Previews the withdrawal (links stop working, nobody is told), waits, then moves it back to Draft and confirms.
expectations: Uses withdraw-preview and then withdraw with its version and --confirmed
Says the signing links stop working and that the participants are not told

evals.prompt: Download the signed PDF of the contract <signed contract>.
evals.expected_output: Downloads the signed PDF to a local temp folder and gives the path, not an address.
expectations: Gives a local file path; prints no signedUrl, S3 address or signing link
Does not print IP, location or other signature evidence
